Container.Name: strixhaven-companion
Container.Overview: Local AI companion for our Strixhaven D&D campaign: rules and adventure Q&A with citations, session tracker, campaign notes, per-player notes and D&D Beyond party import. Needs an Ollama server.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web app (SWAG proxies to this).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Books (sources/), companion.db and extracted text. Must be owned by nobody:users.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Long random string (openssl rand -hex 32). Keep it the same or everyone is logged out.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Address of the Ollama container (use the server's LAN IP, not localhost).

Config.Name: Embedding model
Config.Description: Must match the model the search index was built with.

Config.Name: Admin logins
Config.Description: Login names that can open the Usage page (comma separated, e.g. Aldric). The DM is not an admin unless listed.

Config.Name: GPU layers
Config.Description: Model layers forced onto the GPU (99 = all). Needed on the Intel Arc: Ollama's own fit check misreads free memory and runs on the CPU. Empty = let Ollama decide.

Config.Name: Context size
Config.Description: Tokens of context. Raise to 8192 only if answers stay fast (model must fit in GPU memory).
